item.title: The cycle and pedestrian lights on the turn from Procter St to High Holborn are green at the same time., 8th October
item.description:
The traffic lights for pedestrians and cyclists are green at the same time on the curve from Procter Street to High Holborn. Cyclists ride very fast around that curve, and there have been many near misses because pedestrians do not know that cyclists also think they have right of way. This seems to be a recent issue, over the past month or so.
